$comment: Not enforced by a validator (deliberately -- keeping this cheap beats keeping it exhaustive). Documents the shape scripts/generate-parity-matrix.mjs expects from every */parity.json and docs/parity/*.json. Add a field here in the same PR that adds it to a manifest.
sdk_id: string -- short slug, must match the SDK's directory name (javascript/react/angular/widget/dotnet/python/flutter/swift)
tier: 'active' | 'maintenance' -- active: gets new-capability build effort as the platform grows. maintenance: real, working, tested, kept alive (bug fixes + security patches land), but not proactively built ahead of parity. This is a founder-level call, not something to flip without one -- see each maintenance-tier manifest's tier_reason.
tier_reason: string -- why this tier, and since when
last_verified_against_api: YYYY-MM-DD -- date someone last actually read this SDK's source against the platform API (not the date this file was edited for typos)
verification_method: string -- how (grep/read of what, against what)

capabilities.auth: {login, register, refresh, logout, password_reset, email_verification}: bool, plus 'evidence' or 'note'
capabilities.chat: {create_conversation, list_conversations, get_conversation, close_conversation, send_message, get_messages, mark_read, typing_indicator}: bool, plus 'evidence' or 'note'
capabilities.widgets: {create, list, get, update}: bool, plus 'evidence' or 'note'
capabilities.rag: {supported: bool}, plus 'note' -- true for zero SDKs today; RagController.cs exists platform-side and nothing wraps it yet
capabilities.webhooks: {supported: bool}, plus 'note' -- true for zero SDKs today; no customer-facing outbound webhook API exists on the platform yet

notes: string -- freeform, the most important field for a human skimming PARITY.md
